name: HoloBench
summary:
HoloBench brings a holographic workbench into your room. Use hand tracking or Touch controllers on Quest 3 and 3S. Work at your own desk in passthrough, or step into a virtual beach house or lounge.

- BUILD: Assemble simplified machines piece by piece, from a robot arm to a space station. Follow guided steps, then pull the model apart, replay the build, or run an illustrative animation.
- SHAPE: Pinch, twist and stretch eight interactive forms, including a fractal tree, a shell and a miniature planet.
